# OpenMausBot

- **Upstream:** https://github.com/milind-soni/OpenMausBot
- **Commit:** `310e731edbf628ad2086bd782f0f6cfb7f3431cd`
- **Licence:** Apache-2.0

## Why we vendor it

OpenMausBot (Apache-2.0, `enterprise/` excluded and never fetched) is the reference for driving the user's own `claude`/`codex` CLIs (ADR 0004). Its engine layer is tightly coupled: `server/procs.ts` alone imports about 15 internal modules. So **only self-contained pieces are vendored now**. The engine layer is ported deliberately in v0.2.

| Upstream file | What we take | Belay destination | Feature |
|---|---|---|---|
| `shared/redact.ts` | High-precision secret redaction (`redactSecretsInText`, `mask`). It recognises Anthropic/OpenAI/Stripe/GitHub/GitLab/Slack/HF and other key shapes and keeps the shape, not the value. No imports. | **Adapt** at `core/packages/belayd/src/redact.ts`, used before storing command summaries, in the Logbook, in share cards, and for B4 clipboard masking | A3, G1, B4, `architecture.md` §6 |
| `server/group-exec.ts` | Spawn a child in its **own process group** and stop the whole group (SIGTERM, then SIGKILL after a grace period), so stopping an agent also stops what it started (git helpers, ssh, dev servers). Imports only `node:child_process`. | **Adapt** at `core/packages/belayd/src/crew/process-group.ts` | Crew stop / "lower everyone" (`docs/crew.md` §9), J1 |
| `DESIGN.md` | OpenMausBot's design rules: calm by default, three ink levels, token-only colour, strict type/radius/space scales, bare icons, border-or-tint, motion that explains (300 ms ceiling), words. dusk bot's look descends from these; dusk bot itself is off-limits (ADR 0008). | **Adapted** into `docs/design.md` (Belay design rules) and `.claude/skills/belay-design/` | All UI (E3, settings, notch) |

**v0.2 porting list (read from `refs/OpenMausBot`, not vendored yet):**
- `server/cli-probe.ts`: run `--version` with PATH only, never inherited credentials.
- `server/cli-version-probe.ts`, `server/env-path.ts` (`findCliCandidates`, `augmentedPath`): locate the user's CLIs.
- `server/engine-check.ts`: a one-message "is this engine signed in" check with friendly errors.
- `server/drivers/acp/`: MausBot drives agents through ACP drivers. Evaluate ACP versus plain `claude -p` / `codex exec` for J1/J2.

**Apache-2.0 obligations:**
- Keep `LICENSE` and `NOTICE` (copied here).
- Mark adapted files as changed with a header: `// Adapted from OpenMausBot (Apache-2.0), <upstream path> @ 310e731e. Modified by Belay contributors. See third_party/OpenMausBot/.`
- Adapted files stay under Apache-2.0 inside the MIT project.
